lines.text: Six rules make anything look like a nineties video game.
One. Low poly. Three hundred triangles, flat shading.
Two. Sixty-four pixel textures, painted by code.
Three. Render it tiny. Two seventy by four eighty. No smoothing.
Four. Snap every vertex to a grid, and dither the colors.
Five. Slice it open, and label one part.
Six. A new pose on every sentence.
